title: Perfume Bottle Light Study
prompt: A faceted perfume bottle with amber liquid and a gold cap on a glossy plinth, against a saturated magenta backdrop. A hard light slowly sweeps across it while the camera pushes in.
description: Use a thick faceted shell and a separate liquid volume, then move a hard key and caustic gobo across a small studio set.

brief.prompt: A faceted perfume bottle with amber liquid and a gold cap on a glossy plinth, against a saturated magenta backdrop. A hard light slowly sweeps across it while the camera pushes in.

tags.lighting: sweeping hard spot and a caustic gobo

techniques: lathed glass shell with an inner wall
caustic gobo follows the glass shadow
